file

You can check this without us. Hash the file, look the block up on any explorer. If we disappeared tomorrow the check would still work.
THEIR WORD
Whose land it is, how many acres, which crop, and the sowing date.
Nobody has visited the field. The location a phone reports can be faked in one tap, so it is filed as claimed and labelled that way everywhere.
NOBODY KNOWS
Whether the crop succeeds.
Which is why there is no projected return anywhere in this product. A total loss can return less than you put in.
